args.message:
Fix money rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The docstring claimed banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing nightly test failures in
tests/test_money.py. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so 2.665 rounds to 2.66.

args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py` documented banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py` (e.g. `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).
- Changed the import and the `quantize` call to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Testing
- CI run on this branch passed (run `ci-0001`, all tests green).

Fixes the nightly failure; requested review from @alex.
args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
